name: Computer Engineering
description: The Department of Computer Engineering at AIKTC offers a comprehensive, industry-aligned engineering education that seamlessly combines algorithmic foundations with hands-on modern software and systems engineering. The department focuses on high-impact computing paradigms including Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Cloud Architecture, Full-Stack Web Development, Cyber Security, Database Systems, and Distributed Computing. Through experiential learning, collaborative hackathons (like Algorithm 8.0), and industry internships, students acquire both deep theoretical problem-solving capabilities and industry-ready engineering skills.
highlights: Approved intake of 120 seats affiliated with the University of Mumbai and approved by AICTE & DTE Maharashtra.
State-of-the-art specialized labs including Machine Learning Lab, Data Engineering Lab, Cloud Computing Lab, and Systems Programming Lab with 12th Gen Intel Core i5 workstations.
Active student professional chapters including ACM, CSI (Computer Society of India), and Developer Student Clubs organizing nationwide coding hackathons and workshops.
Strong placement track record with top recruiters including TCS, Infosys, Capgemini, Jio, Accenture, L&T Infotech, and tech startups.
career_opportunities: Software Development Engineer (SDE), Full-Stack Developer, Cloud Solutions Architect, Machine Learning Engineer, Systems Analyst, Cyber Security Specialist, and Database Administrator.
vision: To be the most sought after academic, research and practice based department of Computer Engineering that others would wish to emulate.
